description: Initiative 0002 Slice 5: survey extraction baseline for pack_01_clean and pack_03_mismatch_and_cert_gap: extract certification parties and baseline callouts with locked citations, and surface missing lender certification as a structured issue code.

userStories.title: Extract certification parties with citations
userStories.description: Extract survey certification parties into structured fields backed by lockable citations so the row can be verified and trusted.
acceptanceCriteria: For pack_01_clean, certification parties extracted match truth key fields where truth supports them.
Each extracted party field has lockable citations; row is needs_review when verification passes.
Candidate citations are chunk IDs; citations are locked and immutable before verification (no free-text citations).

userStories.title: Flag certification gap as structured issue code
userStories.description: Surface missing lender certification as a machine-readable issue code with evidence on the cert gap pack, without fabricating missing data.
acceptanceCriteria: For pack_03_mismatch_and_cert_gap, missing lender certification is surfaced as a structured issue code (e.g. CERT_MISSING_LENDER) with citation to the certification block.
No fabricated lender name is emitted when lender is missing; the field is absent/unknown.
If no citations can be locked due to low extraction quality, row falls back safely to missing_input with remediation checklist (no invented callouts).
